title: 108 Heroes of Liangshan
lines: Song Jiang, the Timely Rain, became the leader of Liangshan. He was a man of contradictions — a former clerk who wrote poetry, a fugitive who wept for his country, a bandit who dreamed of imperial recognition.

Under his command, the 108 heroes built a miniature kingdom in the marsh. They redistributed wealth from corrupt officials to the poor. They never harmed the common people. Every battle song, drinking cup, and oath taken was a rebuke to the court that had rejected them.

Wu Yong the Wizard plotted their strategies. Li Kui the Black Whirlwind fought with twin axes and a berserker rage. Yan Qing the Prodigal charmed his way through every fortress. Together, they were unstoppable.
But Song Jiang's dream was always to earn amnesty and serve the Song. When the emperor offered, the heroes of Liangshan marched out of the marsh to fight the empire's wars. Many would never return.
